scope.statement: Transfer partner-uniform endpoint midpoint tail and first/second moments to every edge of the complete actual C-II diameter graph by an injection into distinct endpoints.
scope.domain: Finite canonical C-II sources with D in the upstream endpoint-estimate range; the proof covers all actual diameter edges, and the finite verifier exercises the two stated Woodall graph forms only.
scope.limitations: Conditional on the upstream endpoint midpoint estimates and generic Woodall classification. Does not bound stress-weighted sums or near-diameter pair counts, extract a source set, construct a finite motion, or close C-II or Level I.

result: The full actual diameter graph itself is a straight-line thrackle. Woodall topology gives either a caterpillar forest or one odd cycle with pendant leaves, yielding an injective edge-to-endpoint assignment and termwise tail/moment domination.
remaining_questions: Independently audit the upstream full-source endpoint midpoint tail and moment estimates at the destination's exact candidate bytes.
